_doc: Explicit symbol -> Angel instrument mapping for names that no longer resolve as '<SYMBOL>-EQ' in Angel's scrip master.
Key = the symbol as STORED in price_history (never renamed here; rows keep the stored name so the series continues).
angel_symbol = Angel trading symbol to fetch; its token is looked up in the live scrip master on every run.
nse_symbol = ticker in NSE's bhavcopy, used only for the official-price spot check.
token_seen = token observed when the entry was added. The fetcher warns if the live token differs.
Add an entry only after checking the new instrument's bars equal the stored bars on the overlap days (the tool does this for you on the next --dry-run).
Unresolved symbols are listed in every report together with candidate instruments of the same name.

HFCL.reason: Moved from EQ to the BE (trade-for-trade) series between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-25. HFCL-EQ is gone from the scrip master. The BE token serves the continuous history, including the EQ period; checked against the bhavcopy on 5 dates. Remove this entry if HFCL returns to EQ.

HEG.reason: Ticker renamed HEG -> HEGAM. Stored under HEG. HEGAM then had a demerger (ex 2026-09-07) that Angel back-adjusted, so HEG is currently held back by the corporate-action check (ratio 0.357). See README 'Known quirks'.

_doc_hold_back: hold_back: stored symbols this tool must NEVER extend, whatever the overlap check says.
Each is a known corporate-action seam: its stored history is on the pre-action basis while Angel now serves the adjusted basis, so appending Angel bars would create a fake return at the join.
The CATALAN pre-registration excludes these three from its study universe unless their history is rewritten on a consistent basis.
Remove an entry ONLY after its full history has been deliberately rewritten on one basis (a DELETE+reinsert, outside this tool). The next --dry-run must then show 'overlap exact' for it.
